en: The right to do or say what you want; or the state of not being a prisoner; or the lack of limits on something.
ex: Everyone has the freedom to choose their own career.
每個人都有選擇自己職業的自由。

en: A relationship between friends; or the state of being friends.
ex: Their friendship has lasted for more than thirty years.
他們的友誼已經持續了三十多年。

en: Long thin pieces of potato that are fried in oil (short for French fries).
ex: She ordered a hamburger and a small order of fries.
她點了一個漢堡和一小份薯條。

en: To cook food in hot oil; or a very young fish.
ex: She fried two eggs for breakfast.
她早餐煎了兩顆蛋。

en: Things such as chairs, tables and beds that you put in a room to make it ready to live in.
ex: They bought some new furniture for the living room.
他們為客廳買了一些新傢俱。

en: At or to a greater distance; or more; or to help something to develop.
ex: For further information, please call this number.
如需更多資訊，請撥這個電話。

en: To get something that is useful or wanted; or to increase in amount; or a benefit or profit.
ex: She gained a lot of experience from her first job.
她從第一份工作中累積了很多經驗。

en: Things that you throw away, such as old food and paper.
ex: Please take out the garbage before you go to bed.
睡覺前請把垃圾拿出去倒。

en: A person who looks after a garden, either as a job or for pleasure.
ex: The gardener planted roses along the garden wall.
園丁沿著花園的牆種了玫瑰。

en: Kind and calm in the way you speak or behave; or not strong or violent.
ex: The nurse has a gentle voice and kind manner.
那位護理師聲音溫柔，態度親切。

en: A polite word for any man; or a man who behaves politely and kindly.
ex: A gentleman always opens the door for a lady.
紳士總是為女士開門。

en: A tall African animal with a very long neck and legs, and brown spots on its coat.
ex: A giraffe can reach leaves at the tops of tall trees.
長頸鹿可以吃到高大樹頂上的葉子。

en: A sticky substance used to join things together; or to join things with this substance.
ex: She used glue to stick the pieces of paper together.
她用膠水把這些紙片黏在一起。

en: Something you want to achieve; or the area where players try to send the ball in sports; or a point scored.
ex: Our goal is to finish the project by the end of the month.
我們的目標是月底前完成這項專案。

en: A farm animal with horns and a beard that is kept for its milk or meat.
ex: The farmer keeps goats and sheep on the hillside.
農夫在山坡上養山羊和綿羊。

en: A shiny yellow metal that is very valuable and used to make jewelry; or the color of this metal.
ex: She won the gold medal in the swimming race.
她在游泳比賽中贏得了金牌。

en: Made of gold or colored like gold; or very good; or happy and successful.
ex: The field of wheat looked golden in the evening sun.
麥田在夕陽下看起來金黃一片。

en: A large white bird with a long neck that lives near water; or the meat of this bird.
ex: A flock of wild geese flew over the lake.
一群野雁飛過湖面。

en: Happening slowly over a long time rather than suddenly.
ex: There has been a gradual improvement in her health.
她的健康狀況逐漸好轉。

en: The seeds of plants such as wheat and rice that are used as food; or a very small, hard piece of something; or the pattern in wood.
ex: The farmer stores the grain in a large barn.
農夫把穀物存放在一座大穀倉裡。

en: A unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.
ex: The recipe needs two hundred grams of sugar.
這道食譜需要兩百公克的糖。

en: Very impressive in size or beauty; or very important; or large and grand.
ex: The hotel has a grand entrance with marble floors.
這家飯店有一個鋪著大理石地板的氣派大門。

en: A small, round or oval fruit that grows in bunches and is eaten fresh or made into wine or juice.
ex: She ate a bunch of sweet grapes for dessert.
她吃了一串甜葡萄當甜點。

en: The process of increasing in size or amount; or the way something develops.
ex: The company has seen rapid growth in recent years.
這家公司近年來快速成長。

en: A person who protects a place or person; or to protect something; or to stop people from entering.
ex: The guard stood at the gate all night.
警衛整夜站在大門口。

en: A round tropical fruit with a green skin, pink or white flesh, and many hard seeds.
ex: Guava is a popular fruit in Taiwan.
芭樂是台灣很受歡迎的水果。

en: A person who shows tourists around a place; or a book that gives information; or to show someone the way.
ex: The guide showed us around the old temple.
導遊帶我們參觀了那座古廟。

en: A weapon that fires bullets.
ex: The police officer carried a gun on his belt.
警察的腰帶上掛著一把槍。

en: A large room or building with equipment for physical exercise.
ex: He goes to the gym three times a week.
他每週去健身房三次。

en: The act of cutting someone's hair; or the style in which hair has been cut.
ex: You need a haircut; your hair is too long.
你需要剪頭髮了，你的頭髮太長了。

en: A large room used for meetings, concerts or events; or the area just inside the front door of a building; or a passage in a building.
ex: The school ceremony took place in the main hall.
學校典禮在大禮堂舉行。

en: A round, flat piece of cooked beef in a bread roll; or the meat itself.
ex: We had hamburgers for lunch at a fast-food restaurant.
我們午餐在速食店吃了漢堡。

en: To deal with a problem or situation; or to touch or hold something with your hands; or the part of an object you hold.
ex: She handled the difficult situation very calmly.
她非常冷靜地處理了這個困難的情況。

en: Good-looking, especially a man; or large in amount.
ex: He is a tall, handsome young man.
他是個高大英俊的年輕人。

en: Almost not at all; or only just; or with difficulty.
ex: It was so dark that I could hardly see anything.
天太黑了，我幾乎什麼也看不見。

en: The place where, in some religions, God lives and good people go after they die; or a perfect place.
ex: The island is like heaven on earth with its white beaches.
這座島有著白色沙灘，宛如人間天堂。

en: Very much or to a high degree; or with strong approval.
ex: The movie is highly recommended by many critics.
這部電影受到許多影評人的極力推薦。

en: A large main road between towns or cities where vehicles can travel fast.
ex: The highway was crowded with traffic during the holiday.
假期期間高速公路上擠滿了車。

en: The part of the body on each side of the waist, above the legs; or a fruit of a rose plant; or trendy.
ex: She put her hands on her hips and looked at him angrily.
她雙手叉腰，生氣地看著他。

en: A large African animal with a big head and thick gray skin that lives near water.
ex: The hippopotamus spends most of the day in the water.
河馬一天大部分的時間都待在水裡。
